plugins.cameraPermissionText: CivicAI uses the camera to scan your CNIC and photograph civic problems.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CivicAI uses the camera to scan your CNIC and photograph civic problems.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CivicAI uses your photo library so you can attach an existing photograph.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: CivicAI uses the microphone so you can describe a problem by voice.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CivicAI uses your location to tag where a problem is, only when you tap "Use my location".
